# What fuse-figma's `test:capture` capture check reads, as git pathspecs, one per line. On a pull
# request or push with a known base, the merge workflow's figma-capture legs skip the check when
# none of these changed since that base (.github/scripts/figma-compare-affected.sh with INPUTS
# naming this file); a manual dispatch or an unknown base always runs it.
# test/merge-task-graph.test.mjs checks that the package of every task the legs schedule and every
# file Turbo hashes for the legs' capture tasks is listed.
# Its unit tests and the plugin's fake-file Plan differential run in the job, so they count.

# fuse-figma's sources and scripts
packages/fuse-figma
:(exclude)packages/fuse-figma/README.md
# The facts leg's suites import the helpers in test/, but not its tests or fixtures
:(exclude,glob)packages/fuse-figma/test/**/*.test.ts
:(exclude)packages/fuse-figma/test/fixtures

# The Fuse build the cells render, its build scripts, and the sources the kit reads directly
packages/fuse/src
:(exclude,glob)packages/fuse/src/**/*.test.*
:(exclude,glob)packages/fuse/src/**/__snapshots__/**
packages/fuse/scripts
packages/fuse/package.json
packages/fuse/tsconfig.json
packages/fuse/tsdown.config.ts

# The color package, which Fuse's theme and the kit import from source
packages/color/src
:(exclude,glob)packages/color/src/**/*.test.*
packages/color/package.json

# The TypeScript config the builds extend
tooling/typescript

# Dependencies and the task graph
package.json
pnpm-lock.yaml
pnpm-workspace.yaml
patches
turbo.json

# The job and its setup
.github/workflows/merge.yml

.github/scripts/figma-compare-affected.sh
.github/figma-capture-inputs.txt

# The API references whose placement defaults the anchored manifests name
